title: Time sheets still list a non-technician with Time Clock on
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member A, on the built-in Parts Manager role, with Time Clock on and Technician off, enrolled at the test location only.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member C, on the built-in Office User role, with Time Clock on, enrolled at the test location, so the list's existing Office User rule is checked too.
  • Have a new service work order for this test, work order 1, at the test location, in Approved, led by nobody (no lead).
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Time Sheets tab.
  3. Open the technician filter on the Time Sheets tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The Time Sheets tab shows.

Step 3:

  • Staff member A is listed, as today.
  • Staff member C is not listed, as today.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11881 (Story 3, Who appears on the technician lists)

  • S3-R9: “Lists that are not technician lists keep everyone with Time Clock on except the Office User and Time Clock User roles, as today: time sheets and the time sheet dialogs, Punch Clock Activities, the Technician Efficiency and Technician Utilization reports, and the schedule (which follows departments).”
  • Out of Scope: “Clocking in on a job. Anyone with Time Clock on can still press Start on an approved line and record time, as today. Time sheets, the time sheet dialogs and Punch Clock Activities keep listing everyone with Time Clock on except the Office User and Time Clock User roles, as today.”
  • Key Decisions: “Only the lists used to assign work, and Board View and Tech View, change. Time sheets, reports and the schedule keep everyone they list today.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Technician Toggle" (https://claude.ai/artifact/1fuPz8Y4xTg7Syq1mfmJ9R), version 1793629882-06f7, read 2 Nov 2026: page "6 Technician dropdowns on a work order" (board note; no picture)

The design's own words:

  • “Time sheets keep every Time Clock user: a Parts Manager can still clock in and record time. Part sales have no technician dropdown on screen, so nothing there looks different.”
